prompt: Create a dashboard layout with a header showing the page title 'Analytics', then a row of 4 metric cards (Total Users, Revenue, Conversion, Active Sessions), and below that a two-column grid with a chart area and a recent activity list.
assertions: Uses .wa-stack for the overall vertical page flow
Uses .wa-grid with --min-column-size for the metric cards row
Uses Card component for metric cards (not raw divs)
Uses a grid or .wa-grid for the two-column chart+activity section
Includes npx kigumi add for Card and other needed components
Uses className (not class) on all elements
